integrity: All stated global identities and uniqueness claims are proved analytically. Reproducible numerical tests are supplementary; no independent audit or field validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes homogeneous Poisson carcass arrivals, two equal-quality independent instantaneous imperfect searches, finite nondegenerate positive exponential mixtures of carcass removal lifetimes, and known parameters; it neither calibrates a particular road nor treats variable detection efficiency or travel costs.
title: A unique horizon reversal for mean-matched carcass-persistence survey calendars
